about_the_game:
Beyond The Rift is a multiplayer space adventure set in a vast, evolving universe filled with discovery, danger, and opportunity. Command your own vessel, explore uncharted systems, and decide what kind of captain you’ll become. Play solo or with a trusted crew, and forge your story.

Crew-Based Gameplay

A starship thrives on teamwork, but not every captain needs a crew. Larger vessels demand coordination across multiple roles to reach their full potential, while smaller ships reward skill, precision, and quick decision-making.

Shared Universe

The galaxy is alive with other captains and crews, each chasing their own ambitions. You might encounter friendly traders, ambitious explorers, or unpredictable outlaws. Whether you choose diplomacy or confrontation, every meeting shapes your reputation among the stars.

Exploration & Discovery

Exploration lies at the heart of Beyond The Rift. Investigate derelict ships, decode strange signals, and uncover remnants of lost civilizations. In the void there are many secrets to uncover and stories to tell, some best left undisturbed.

Mining & Industry

Gather resources to fuel your journey and expand your capabilities. Deploy mining drones, harvest asteroids, and refine rare materials to upgrade your ship or trade for profit. The economy is ever-changing, shaped by opportunity and risk.

Trade & Economy

Build your reputation as a merchant, smuggler, or opportunist. Influence supply lines, manipulate markets, and turn information—or deception—into profit.

Combat & Conflict

When words fail, weapons speak. Engage in tactical ship-to-ship battles where power management, precision, and timing decide the outcome. Target subsystems, disable engines, and seize what remains. Every fight carries risk, but the spoils go to those who dare.

Procedural Rifts

Across the galaxy, unstable rifts tear through space and time. Inside these anomalies lie alien technology, strange phenomena, and unimaginable rewards. Enter at your own risk, few emerge unchanged.

Beyond The Rift blends exploration, teamwork, and emergent multiplayer encounters in a universe that feels alive and unpredictable. Whether you are a lone explorer or command a well-coordinated crew, your journey will shape the legends told across the stars.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Dive into a multiplayer space adventure in a vast, evolving universe of discovery, danger, and opportunity. Command your ship solo or with crew, explore uncharted systems, mine resources, trade wisely, engage in combat, and venture the void for hidden treasures. Forge your stellar legacy.
